_comment: Add this to your Claude Desktop configuration to enable the CimPal MCP server.
_how_to_use: Merge the 'mcpServers' block into your existing claude_desktop_config.json. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH with the absolute path to CimPal-CLI.jar.

cimpal._note_root: File paths in tool calls must lie under a --root (repeatable; --read-root for read-only folders, --write-root for outputs). Without one, only the folder Claude Desktop starts the server in is allowed, which is rarely your data folder. Replace REPLACE_WITH_DATA_PATH with your models/constraints/output folder, e.g. C:/Data/CimPal.
cimpal._note_args: Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH with the absolute path to the CimPal-CLI.jar file, e.g. C:/Tools/CimPal/CimPal-CLI.jar. The 'mcp' argument starts the MCP server on stdio.
cimpal._note_memory: For large CGMES models, add JVM memory flags before -jar: ["-Xmx8g", "-jar", "..."] to give the server 8 GB heap.
cimpal._note_debug: To see MCP message traffic, add '--debug' after 'mcp': [..., "mcp", "--debug"]. Debug output goes to stderr, not the MCP channel.
